key_terms.اكْسِرْهُ: Break it, referring to diluting or altering the drink's state.
key_terms.النَّبِيذ: Nabeez, a fermented drink made from raisins or barley, often cited in hadith regarding intoxicants.
key_terms.بِالْمَاءِ: With water, the agent used to dilute the drink.
key_terms.فُلَانِيٌّ: So-and-so, implying a label of sectarian identity (e.g., 'He is a Shia').

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on adding water to Nabeez to make it permissible to drink?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi illustrates the Shia juristic principle of 'kadr al-khamr' (dilution) in social contexts, where Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) advises breaking the drink with water to maintain social harmony without fully consuming the prohibited substance. The clarification that one should not drink it even after dilution highlights the distinction between the physical act of breaking the intoxicant's strength and the ritual prohibition of consumption, reflecting the nuanced approach to avoiding 'fitna' (social discord) while adhering to purity laws.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Hameed, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub, from Amro Bin Marwan who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws that they (people), sometimes I am present with them for dinner so they are coming with Al-Nabeez after that. So if I do not drink, I fear that they would be saying, ‘So and so (A Shia)’. So how shall I deal with it?’ So heasws said: ‘Break it with the water’. I said, ‘So when I break it with the water, can I drink it (Al Nabeez)?’ Heasws said: ‘No’.
en.sarwar: 13. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Hamid from Yunus ibn Ya‘qub from ‘Amr ibn Marwan who has said the following:

“I once said to abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘I may go with these people for dinner and they bring al-Nabidh thereafter. If I do not drink I fear they may say, ‘He is of so and so (Ja‘fariy). What must I do in such case?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘You can break it with water.’ I then asked, ‘When I break it with water can I then drink it?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘No, you cannot drink.’”
